note: v497: The bell now clears when you tick tonight's job done from Home — the red dot on the bell and the app icon used to hang around until you changed pages. If a load fails and you tap Retry, it refreshes the page you're actually on instead of always the Dashboard. The collapse toggle on every card (Upcoming, Cash Flow, Spend, Spending by Category, Calendar, Reports, the loan payment calendar) can now be reached by keyboard and is announced properly by VoiceOver, and Home's tappable rows keep that support when they redraw.
